notes: Adding debts is quicker: the form asks only for balance, APR and minimum (name and minimum are optional). Type, lender, due date, limit and 0% promo sit under More details.
Add all your debts in one go: tap Save & add another debt and the form is ready for the next one, with your debt-free date updating as you go.
Type a name like "Car loan" or pick a lender and the debt type is set for you.
A minimum you left blank is estimated and marked (est.) on the debt until you change it.
